solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Singer wrong to stick with a cunning comeback?

parts.note: a wrong, as a noun, is a sin

indicators.note: a comeback signals the word for cunning turning round to read backwards

parts.note: cunning, as a noun, is art or craft

explanation.surface: A question whether it is a mistake to rely on a crafty return.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cunning' looks like an adjective describing the comeback, but here it is a noun meaning skill or craft.
explanation.definitionFit: Frank Sinatra was the celebrated American crooner and vocalist.

clue.text: Writer outside in sunshine clutches pen

indicators.note: clutches means the outer letters hold the pen word inside them
outside in takes the letters on the outside of sunshine, its first and last

parts.note: a crib is a pen or stall for animals

explanation.surface: A writer sitting outdoors in the sun gripping a pen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pen' looks like the writer's tool but is an animal enclosure.
explanation.definitionFit: A scribe is a copyist or professional writer.

clue.text: TV channel set up in North America — this region?

indicators.note: in places the turned channel inside the abbreviation
set up in a down clue turns the channel name upwards, reading in reverse

parts.note: Dave is a British TV channel showing repeats

explanation.surface: A TV channel being launched in North America.
explanation.walkthrough: Dave is a British channel known for showing repeats; the question mark marks the definition as a hint by example.
explanation.definitionFit: Nevada is a western US state, a region of North America as the clue suggests.

clue.text: Violent end to demonstration raised complaint

indicators.note: violent means the letters of end to are thrown into disorder
raised in a down clue lifts the protest word so it reads upwards, in reverse

parts.note: a sit-in is a form of protest demonstration

explanation.surface: A protest ending in violence leads to a raised grievance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'complaint' reads as a protester's grievance but means an ailment; a sit-in is a protest where people occupy a place.
explanation.definitionFit: Tendonitis is inflammation of a tendon, a medical ailment.

clue.text: Notice university supported by banks in light blue

indicators.note: supported by in a down clue puts the banks underneath the rest

parts.note: a notice is an ad

indicators.note: banks in takes the edges of light, its first and last letters

explanation.surface: An advert for a university with light blue colours, as Cambridge has.
explanation.walkthrough: 'light blue' looks like one colour; 'blue' alone is the definition, meaning risqué.
explanation.definitionFit: Blue films and jokes are risqué, the same sense as adult entertainment.

clue.text: Herbaceous wild flower cut back, decays — pecked on the outside

indicators.note: the word for pecked sits on the outside, wrapping round the other piece

parts.note: a bird that pecked something bit it

indicators.note: cut back here tells us the word for decays is pruned back, read in reverse order

parts.note: decays means rots

explanation.surface: A garden plant pruned, rotting and pecked at by birds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut back' reads as gardening advice but is the reversal signal. Bistort is a pink-flowered plant of damp meadows.
explanation.definitionFit: Bistort is a European knotweed, a perennial plant with spikes of pink blooms growing in meadows.

clue.text: European city boozer with tea? Yankee leaves area

parts.note: a boozer is British slang for a pub or bar

indicators.note: leaves means the letter for Yankee departs from the tea

parts.note: Ceylon is a type of tea
Yankee is Y in the radio alphabet

explanation.surface: A pub that serves tea, once the American has left the place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaves' also suggests tea leaves, but means Y is removed from CEYLON.
explanation.definitionFit: Barcelona is the Catalan capital on Spain's Mediterranean coast.

clue.text: Mum's supplied with hip bone

parts.note: mum as in keeping mum means silent, so sh
hip means fashionable, in

explanation.surface: Mother is provided with a hip bone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mum' is not a mother but means silent.
explanation.definitionFit: The shin is the front of the leg, its bone being the tibia.

clue.text: Fat old couple eating enjoy life at the Italian

indicators.note: eating means the pair of letters takes the verb inside
couple means two of them, so the abbreviation is doubled

parts.note: to live is to enjoy life to the full
il is Italian for the

explanation.surface: An elderly couple living it up eating fatty food at an Italian restaurant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'old couple' gives O and O, which surround LIVE.
explanation.definitionFit: Olive oil is a fat used in cooking, pressed from fruit.

clue.text: House English chaps in temporary accommodation

indicators.note: in places these letters inside the temporary shelter

parts.note: a tent is temporary accommodation
chaps are men

explanation.surface: Englishmen housed in temporary lodging.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenement is a dwelling, often a large building divided into flats.

clue.text: Bird close to exhaustion after party

indicators.note: after places the closing letter behind the word for party

parts.note: a rave is a lively party

indicators.note: close to means the end of the word exhaustion, its final letter

explanation.surface: Someone nearly worn out after a night of partying.
explanation.definitionFit: A raven is a large black member of the crow family.

clue.text: Language from punk regularly pelting Scotsman?

indicators.note: regularly picks every other letter of punk, the second and fourth

parts.note: pelting, as a noun, is heavy rain
Ian is a typically Scottish man's name

explanation.surface: Punk-style language thrown at a man from Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: Ukrainian is the Slavic tongue spoken in Ukraine.

clue.text: Smeared foundation around part of face, on commercial

indicators.note: around means the foundation word wraps the other two pieces

parts.note: a bed is a foundation or base layer, as in a road bed

indicators.note: on in an across clue puts the facial feature after the commercial

parts.note: an ad is a commercial
the mouth is a part of the face

explanation.surface: Make-up foundation smeared round the mouth, perhaps for a TV advert.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Smeared' looks like a make-up instruction but means slandered.
explanation.definitionFit: To smear someone is to slander them, which is what bad-mouthing means.

clue.text: Bug Roger Moore secretly reveals

indicators.note: secretly says the letters are concealed inside the actor's name

explanation.surface: An actor quietly reveals an illness or a spying device.
explanation.definitionFit: A bug is a germ, the microbe causing a minor illness.

clue.text: Bill put on sauce counter is subject to change

parts.note: a bill is a poster or advert, an ad
jus is a thin meat sauce
a table is a counter or flat surface

explanation.surface: A bill added to the sauce on the counter, open to revision.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bill' looks like a restaurant bill but means an advertisement.
explanation.definitionFit: Something adjustable can be altered or modified as needed.

clue.text: Artist appearing in print media, unusually

indicators.note: unusually means the letters are arranged in an unusual order

parts.note: something appearing, being shown, is on

explanation.surface: An artist featuring in newspapers and magazines, a rare event.
explanation.walkthrough: ON (appearing) and PRINT MEDIA are rearranged together; 'in' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Piet Mondrian was the Dutch abstract painter of grids and primary colour blocks.

clue.text: Fair model, I'm not sure, over fifty?

indicators.note: over means the hesitation is put over, in place of, the numeral

parts.note: a template is a model or pattern
L is the Roman numeral for fifty
er is a hesitant noise meaning I am not sure

explanation.surface: A model unsure whether she looks good past fifty.
explanation.walkthrough: In TEMPLATE the L (fifty) is replaced by ER.
explanation.definitionFit: Fair weather is mild, and temperate means mild in climate.

clue.text: Pasty left among foreign booze, seeing theatrical performance

indicators.note: among puts these letters inside the drink

parts.note: sake is Japanese rice wine
pasty means pale, wan

explanation.surface: A pale person among imported drinks, watching a show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pasty' looks like a pie but means pale.
explanation.definitionFit: Swan Lake is the Tchaikovsky ballet, staged as a theatrical performance.

clue.text: Music-player from Irish county keeping in tune primarily

indicators.note: keeping means the county holds the word in inside it

parts.note: Clare is a county in the west of Ireland

indicators.note: primarily picks the first letter of tune

explanation.surface: A musician from an Irish county keeping in tune above all.
explanation.definitionFit: A clarinet is a woodwind instrument, so something that plays music.

clue.text: Politician at front of House, shivering, having passed Bill

indicators.note: having passed places the name for Bill in front of the rest

parts.note: Bill is short for William

indicators.note: front of picks the first letter of House

parts.note: an ague is a fever with shivering fits

explanation.surface: A politician trembling in the Commons after a bill went through.
explanation.walkthrough: An ague is an old word for a malarial fever marked by shivering.
explanation.definitionFit: William Hague was Conservative Party leader and later Foreign Secretary in Britain.

clue.text: Prog-rock band with mansion oddly rejected Texan place

parts.note: ELP is Emerson, Lake and Palmer, a progressive rock band

indicators.note: oddly rejected means the odd letters of mansion are thrown away, leaving the even ones

explanation.surface: A progressive rock band turned away from a mansion in Texas.
explanation.definitionFit: El Paso is a city in western Texas on the Mexican border.

clue.text: Head of gunners comes in to consider heaving man on board

indicators.note: comes in to means that letter goes inside the turned verb
heaving in a down clue lifts the verb upwards, so it reads in reverse

parts.note: to consider is to think

indicators.note: head of picks the first letter of gunners

explanation.surface: A gunner comes in to think about heaving a man aboard ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heaving' turns THINK round to KNIHT; 'comes in to' puts G inside it. 'board' is a chessboard.
explanation.definitionFit: A knight is a chess piece, so a man on the chessboard.

clue.text: Classical leading man that finishes off screen 'eart-throb

indicators.note: finishes off picks the last letter of screen

parts.note: a heart-throb is a hero, and the dropped H shown by the apostrophe removes its first letter too

explanation.surface: A leading actor whose charms end up on a cinema screen.
explanation.walkthrough: The apostrophe in ’eart-throb mimics a Cockney dropped H, so HERO loses its H.
explanation.definitionFit: Nero was a Roman emperor, a leader of the classical world.

clue.text: Training in warmth extremely harmful, regarding athletics event

indicators.note: in places the training letters inside the word for warmth

parts.note: warmth is heat
PT is physical training

indicators.note: extremely takes the extreme letters of harmful, its first and last

parts.note: on means regarding or about

explanation.surface: Training in hot weather is extremely bad for an athletics event.
explanation.definitionFit: A heptathlon is a seven-discipline athletic competition.

clue.text: Linguistic notation learner used during course

indicators.note: used during means the learner letter is placed within the course word

parts.note: a tide is a course or flow
L is a learner, as on L-plates

explanation.surface: A language learner uses a mark during the course.
explanation.definitionFit: A tilde is the wavy mark over a letter, as in Spanish ñ.

clue.text: James is academic

definitions.meaning: James ... was the American film actor of Rebel Without a Cause
a university officer, the head of a faculty or college

explanation.surface: Someone called James works at a university.
explanation.definitionFit: A dean is a senior college official, and James Dean was the film star.

clue.text: One wearing reddish-brown redirected everybody seeing 1970s film

indicators.note: the numeral is wearing the colour, so it goes inside it
redirected means the colour word is sent the other way, read backwards

parts.note: henna is a reddish-brown colour or dye
one is the Roman numeral I
everybody means all

explanation.surface: Someone in auburn turned towards everyone watching a 1970s movie.
explanation.walkthrough: 'redirected' turns HENNA round to ANNEH, and 'wearing' puts I inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Annie Hall is the 1977 Woody Allen romantic comedy that won Best Picture.

clue.text: Broadcaster, on reflection, totally right in evening dress

indicators.note: on reflection means the word for dress is mirrored, read in reverse

parts.note: garb is dress or clothing

indicators.note: totally right in picks the rightmost letter, the final one of evening

explanation.surface: A presenter thinks again and decides evening wear was just right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'totally right in evening' means the rightmost letter of that word; 'evening dress' is not one phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: Melvyn Bragg is the British TV and radio presenter of The South Bank Show.

clue.text: Two medical departments the latest to denounce coalition

parts.note: ENT is ear, nose and throat, a hospital department
the second of the two departments is ENT again

indicators.note: the latest to means the last letter of denounce

explanation.surface: Two hospital departments, the last to condemn a merger.
explanation.definitionFit: An entente is a friendly alliance or understanding between nations.

clue.text: Occasion held outside where French get level

indicators.note: held outside means the occasion word is placed round the French word

parts.note: an occasion is an event
the French for where is ou

explanation.surface: An event held outdoors at a French venue to make things fair.
explanation.definitionFit: To even out is to make or become level and balanced.
